model_name: KAVACH-AI Multilingual Calibrated Classifier v3.0 (Experimental Benchmark)
model_architecture: TF-IDF (Word (1, 2) n-grams | max_features=5,000 | C=1.5 | Sigmoid Calibrated) + Calibrated Logistic Regression (Platt scaling)

synthetic_dataset_limitations.synthetic_provenance: Evaluated strictly on synthetic domain scenario transcripts (KAVACH synthetic v3).
synthetic_dataset_limitations.telephony_generalization_limit: Does not establish or claim production telephony accuracy in unconstrained real-world environments.
synthetic_dataset_limitations.leakage_isolation: Strict 0% scenario-family, 0% exact dialogue hash, and 0% CID leakage across train, val, and test splits.

production_baseline_status: Active baseline remains v1 in backend/app/ml/artifacts/v1/
